en: Well, I've got a talking donkey.

Right. Well, that's good for 10 shillings,
if you can prove it.
Go ahead, little fella.
Well?
He's just... He's just a little nervous.

He's really quite a chatterbox.
Talk, you boneheaded dolt!

-That's it. I've heard enough. Guards!
-No, no, he talks!
He does.
can talk. I love to talk.

I'm the talkingest
damn thing you ever saw.

-Get her out of my sight.
-No, no!
swear! He can talk!
Hey! I can fly!

-He can fly!
-He can fly!
He can talk!

That's right, fool!
Now I'm a flying, talking donkey.

You might have seen a housefly,
maybe even a superfly,

but I bet you ain't
never seen a donkey fly.
Seize him!
After him! He's getting away!
ru:
Обычно, такой болтун.
Начинай говорить, болван.

Я самая разговорчивая
вещь на свете.

- Конечно говорю, идиот!
Теперь я летающий и говорящий
осел.

Вы видели летающих мух,
даже летающих цокотух,

а вот, кто видел
летающего осла?
